clue.text: Abhors making notes before exams

indicators.note: before places the notes ahead of the exams in the answer

parts.note: D and E are two musical notes of the scale
tests are exams

explanation.surface: Someone hates taking revision notes ahead of their exams.
explanation.definitionFit: To hate something intensely is a synonym for abhorring it.

clue.text: Singular art style initially shows good taste

indicators.note: initially says the art style comes first in the answer, ahead of the singular word

parts.note: Deco, as in Art Deco, is an art style of the 1920s and 30s
rum is an old informal word for odd or singular

explanation.surface: A distinctive artistic style is said to display refinement from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' looks like a first-letter signal but only orders the pieces; RUM is chiefly British slang for strange.
explanation.definitionFit: Propriety and correct behaviour amount to good taste in conduct.

clue.text: Is one surrounded by fish in the country?

indicators.note: surrounded by puts the first pieces inside the fish

parts.note: tuna is a large sea fish
taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether someone is hemmed in by fish somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark covers the surface's oddity: 'in the country?' is the definition, with 'in' only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Tunisia is a North African nation, an example of a country.

clue.text: Foremost sovereign lady is perfect

parts.note: she is a pronoun for a lady
ER, Elizabeth Regina, was the leading monarch, the Queen

explanation.surface: The leading female monarch is said to be flawless.
explanation.walkthrough: ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen; 'is' links.
explanation.definitionFit: Perfect in the sense of utter or complete, as in absolute nonsense.

clue.text: Getting established by compromising others

definitions.meaning: ... a business means getting it started and established
to set someone up is to frame them, compromising them falsely

explanation.definitionFit: Founding something is setting it up, and framing an innocent person is setting them up.

clue.text: He charges account customer

parts.note: a user is a customer of a service

explanation.surface: A bank's client is billed on their account.
explanation.definitionFit: One who charges another with wrongdoing is an accuser, a person bringing an allegation.

clue.text: A bit isolated

parts.note: a part is a bit or portion

explanation.surface: Something is slightly cut off from the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Set apart means separated and isolated from others.

clue.text: Applaud committee for proving cladding

parts.note: to clap is to applaud
a board is a governing committee

explanation.surface: A committee is cheered for testing wall covering.
explanation.definitionFit: Overlapping wooden boards used to cover outside walls form a kind of exterior siding.

clue.text: Warlord is about to impound a detailed painting

indicators.note: to impound means to shut something in, so the reversed word encloses the rest
about signals the word is is turned round
detailed means the painting loses its tail, its last letter

parts.note: a mural is a wall painting

explanation.surface: A military chief is about to seize a finely worked picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns the word is round to SI; 'detailed' (de-tailed) drops the painting's last letter; 'to impound' holds A plus that shortened word inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A samurai was a member of the Japanese military aristocracy, a feudal fighting lord.

clue.text: Trade unionists' air warns of danger

definitions.meaning: The anthem sung by the British labour movement

explanation.definitionFit: The labour movement's song bears this title, and a scarlet banner is a signal of hazard.

clue.text: Glad to have everything included

definitions.meaning: the ... of something is all it holds

explanation.definitionFit: Satisfied means glad, and the contents of a container are all that it holds.

clue.text: Dismayed on seeing a pupil with weapons

parts.note: L for learner, a pupil driver
armed means carrying weapons

explanation.surface: Someone is horrified to see a schoolchild carrying arms.
explanation.walkthrough: L is the learner plate on British cars, so a pupil.
explanation.definitionFit: Being frightened or worried is a synonym for being dismayed.

clue.text: Others keep tutor in check

indicators.note: keep means hold inside, so the others enclose the tutor

parts.note: the rest are the others
to train is to tutor

explanation.surface: Other people keep a teacher under control.
explanation.definitionFit: Holding something in check is self-control or curbing it.

clue.text: Bainbridge is a gem

definitions.meaning: a precious stone, of which emerald and aquamarine are varieties

explanation.definitionFit: The novelist's first name matches the gemstone family that includes emerald.

clue.text: Planned to get to centre point on time

parts.note: a mean is an average or midpoint

explanation.surface: Someone intended to reach the middle point punctually.
explanation.definitionFit: Intended to do something is a synonym for planned.

clue.text: Remains of tree pruned miles from anywhere

explanation.definitionFit: Cut branches are sticks, and remote rural areas are colloquially the backwoods.

clue.text: Scowling when magic ring goes astray

indicators.note: goes astray means the letters wander out of order

explanation.surface: A frown appears when a conjuror's ring is lost.
explanation.definitionFit: Pulling a face of displeasure is a synonym for scowling.

clue.text: Where Catholics congregate as a body

definitions.meaning: Catholics gather at Mass, the church service

explanation.definitionFit: Worshippers attend the Eucharist service, and collectively means all together as a group.

clue.text: Instantly at a disadvantage

explanation.definitionFit: Immediately, and in an awkward fix, are both idiomatic senses of the phrase.

clue.text: Not doing one's rounds? How bizarre!

definitions.meaning: a police officer off the beat is not patrolling

explanation.definitionFit: A constable away from patrol is off the beat, and unconventional means strange.

clue.text: Where head of state tucked into hot pea soup

definitions.text: Where head of state tucked into hot pea soup

indicators.note: tucked into puts one letter within the other words
soup suggests a mixture, so the letters are stirred together
head of picks the first letter of state

explanation.surface: A president eats pea soup in a cafe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head of' gives S from state; 'tucked into' adds it to HOT PEA; 'soup' scrambles the lot.
explanation.definitionFit: A small cafe serving light meals and drinks is a place where one might eat soup.

clue.text: Record nothing for youngsters' party

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A record of nothing for a children's party.
explanation.definitionFit: A dance party with recorded pop music is popular with the young.

clue.text: Elevating experience for water-sports addicts

parts.note: snow is frozen water, so skiers are the water-sports fans carried uphill

explanation.definitionFit: A cable mechanism hauls skiers up slopes, a literal raising for winter sports fans.

clue.text: Live longer by using external clothing

definitions.meaning: a variant of outerwear, worn outside

explanation.definitionFit: Outlasting means living longer, and coats worn outside are outer garments.

clue.text: Rapidly consumed oriental repast

indicators.note: consumed means taken in, so the speed word swallows the letter

parts.note: fast means rapidly
E for east, the Orient

explanation.surface: An eastern meal was gulped down quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: A banquet is a lavish meal or spread.

clue.text: See headland from observatory

parts.note: to view is to see
a point is a promontory or headland

explanation.surface: Look at the cape from the star-gazing building.
explanation.definitionFit: A lookout spot from which to observe is a vantage place.

clue.text: Manservant and porter in Vermont

indicators.note: in places the beer inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: VT is the postal abbreviation for Vermont
porter is a dark beer, an ale

explanation.surface: A butler and a doorman work in a New England state.
explanation.definitionFit: A gentleman's personal attendant is a valet.

clue.text: Establish that penny wants to roam

parts.note: to rove is to roam

explanation.surface: Show that a penny wishes to wander.
explanation.definitionFit: To demonstrate as true is to establish it.

clue.text: The new laic order is principled

indicators.note: order, read as putting in a new order, says these letters are rearranged
new asks for a fresh version of the word before it, a rearranging signal

explanation.surface: A fresh lay religious society holds firm moral values.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' and 'order' together signal the rearranging of THE and LAIC into one word.
explanation.definitionFit: Moral, honest conduct is principled behaviour.

clue.text: Suffer terribly when Genoa is destroyed

indicators.note: destroyed means the words are smashed and rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: People are anguished when an Italian city is ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in torment or agony is to suffer terribly.

clue.text: Class ready to do printing exercise

parts.note: a type is a class or kind
set means ready, as in ready, steady, go

explanation.surface: A class is prepared to carry out a printing task.
explanation.definitionFit: Arranging characters for a press is composing text, the compositor's job.

clue.text: Top Cornish diner

parts.note: Cornwall is in the south-west of England, SW
a diner is an eater

explanation.surface: The best restaurant guest in Cornwall.
explanation.walkthrough: Cornwall is England's south-western county, hence SW.
explanation.definitionFit: A jumper is an upper-body garment, a top.
